source: Solana mainnet-beta, recorded 2026-10-03 (IST) from https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com with getBlock(slot, { encoding: 'base64', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 1, transactionDetails: 'full', rewards: true, commitment: 'confirmed' })
trimmed: Each transaction keeps its raw base64 bytes, version and meta.err/fee/computeUnitsConsumed; logs, balances, inner instructions and loaded addresses are dropped, and rewards keep only the leader's Fee reward. 'complete' blocks keep every non-vote transaction (plus 3 votes); the others keep a sample covering every version / price / failed combination. syntheticIndexes: real priced transactions whose fee payer was re-keyed to the slot leader (leader-paid exclusion).
reference: Computed by an independent Python decoder (legacy, v0 and v1/SIMD-0385 wire formats), not by the code under test.
